name: Qualify WordPress Contact Form 7 leads with Gemini and route them to HubSpot and Slack

parameters.content:
## Qualify WordPress Contact Form 7 leads with Gemini and route them to HubSpot and Slack

### How it works
WordPress sends each Contact Form 7 submission here after its spam check. Gemini sorts it into lead, support or spam and scores leads from 1 to 5, and each kind takes its own route.

### Setup steps
1. **Settings**: describe your business, pick the two Slack channels and check the field names. EU-hosted HubSpot: set `hubspot_app_url` to `https://app-eu1.hubspot.com`.
2. **New Lead Webhook**: add a Header Auth credential and copy the production URL.
3. Connect a [Gemini API key](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) on **Gemini Chat Model**.
4. Connect a [HubSpot private app](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/private-apps) token (contacts read and write) on **Save to HubSpot** and **Add Note**.
5. Connect a [Slack app](https://api.slack.com/apps) token with `chat:write` on both Slack nodes.
6. In WordPress, POST the form fields as JSON to the webhook URL on `wpcf7_before_send_mail`. The description shows how.
7. Test with a realistic enquiry: a message that only says "test" is sorted as spam.

## Receive and qualify
**Lead Fields** reads the submission using the field names in **Settings**. **Qualify Lead** asks Gemini for a category, a score and a one-line summary. If the model fails, **Lead Verdict** passes the lead on unscored.

## Leads
**Save to HubSpot** creates or updates the contact by email and **Add Note** keeps the full message on it. The alert says if anything failed and always carries the submission.

## Support and spam
Support requests skip the CRM. Spam stops here.

You sort contact form submissions for the business described in the message. Decide what the submission is, score it and summarise it in one plain sentence. Judge only from what the visitor wrote; never invent details.
